version: v3 (revision of v2 per review 16 Nov)
topic: Google Search + Gemini 4 Hydrogen: all four announced changes, shown on real AI Mode answers

source.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
source.author: Robby Stein, VP of Product, Google Search

features.1 intent: handle nuanced and complicated questions ... questions with multiple parts, hard-to-understand typos, or highly specific requests
features.2 fan-out + linking: supercharges our query fan-out technique ... conducting simultaneous queries across all the relevant subtopics ... broader range of helpful links ... sites you previously might not have discovered
features.3 visual: more images, structured responses, comparison tables, and custom tools
features.4 language: more highly nuanced and helpful responses across all supported AI Mode languages

source.availability: now available globally in Google Search for all users

demo.captured: 2026-11-16T05:36Z, signed-out laptop browser, Pixel 8 viewport, cap/v4/capture.json
demo.note: AI Mode answers change on every load; everything on screen comes from this one capture. Sub-queries in the fan-out beat are an illustration (Google does not show them) and are labelled as an example.

Samsung Galaxy F36 5G.camera: 50 MP OIS triple rear, 13 MP front

not_shown_on_purpose: Google's 'Sony' label for the Vivo camera (not on vivo.com)

lines.cap: Google Search ka ab tak ka sabse bada upgrade aa gaya
lines.tts: गूगल सर्च का अब तक का सबसे बड़ा अपग्रेड आ गया है।

lines.cap: Google ne khud kaha: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
lines.tts: गूगल ने ख़ुद कहा, जेमिनाई फोर, हाइड्रोजन।

lines.cap: Pehla: poora sawaal ek saath samajhta hai. Budget, camera, battery, sab
lines.tts: पहला। पूरा सवाल एक साथ समझता है। बजट, कैमरा, बैटरी, सब।

lines.cap: Doosra: ek saath kai searches, aur zyada websites ke links milte hain
lines.tts: दूसरा। एक साथ कई सर्चेज़, और ज़्यादा वेबसाइट्स के लिंक मिलते हैं।

lines.cap: Teesra: jawab visual. Asli phones ki table, camera aur battery ke saath
lines.tts: तीसरा। जवाब विज़ुअल। असली फ़ोन्स की टेबल, कैमरा और बैटरी के साथ।

lines.cap: Chautha: apni bhasha mein poocho. Hindi English mix bhi samajhta hai
lines.tts: चौथा। अपनी भाषा में पूछो। हिंदी इंग्लिश मिक्स भी समझता है।

lines.cap: Tum pehle kya poochoge? Comment karo
lines.tts: तुम पहले क्या पूछोगे? कमेंट करो।
